intuition: A Fenwick tree stores partial sums so a point change and a prefix query both touch logarithmically many nodes.

brute_force.approach: Update the array directly and add every value in each requested range.

optimal.approach: Use a one-indexed binary indexed tree for point deltas and obtain a range sum as the difference of two prefixes.
optimal.time: update O(log n), sumRange O(log n)

edge_cases: Updating an index to its existing value contributes a zero delta.
A one-element range is the value at that index.
